thread:
sophia: heads up — saw a spike in our py-client streams this morning. looks like token refresh during an active streaming call ends up stalling the generator and piling requests into the batcher. users see long tail latency / stalled frames. anyone else?

raj: saw the same in prod at ~09:12 UTC. stack shows an auth retry happening mid-stream and the client waits on the refresh lock then resumes but the upstream connection resets. partial frames are delivered. :confused:

ben: repro script i used (py):
```python
# minimal repro: auth refresher racing with streaming read
session = requests.Session()
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {get_token()}"}
resp = session.post(url, headers=headers, stream=True)
for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=None):
    if need_refresh():
        refresh_token()  # triggers lock + new token mid-stream
    process(chunk)
```
When refresh_token replaces the header the server closes socket and client gets truncated frames.

olga: quick mitigation — if token refresh is required, try to send a short GRACEFUL stop (client-side) and reopen stream with new token (cheap reconnect) rather than patching Authorization header mid-connection. also add Retry-After handling on 401/419 from server.

mj: one more wrinkle — rerank batching helper is merging paginated results across reconnects and i hit a dims mismatch. error log: `ValueError: embedding dim mismatch, expected 1536, got 1024` when concatenating batches after a reconnect/prefetch. likely because two model variants returned different dims (legacy vs. quantized).

raj: that explains the downstream failures. combine that with buffered batches = silent corruption. we should validate dims per-item before stacking. quick suggestion for BatchHelper in both py/go: validate_meta = item.get("emb_dim") or infer from len(vec); if any mismatch raise or drop + warn.

ben: i put together a tiny check in the PR branch (refs PR #482):
```python
# in batcher.py
def _ensure_dims(batch):
    dims = {len(x) for x in batch}
    if len(dims) > 1:
        raise ValueError(f"embedding dim mismatch: {dims}")
```
Also updated the paginator to flush partial batch on reconnect.

ci-bot: CI: tests/embeddings::test_dim_mismatch FAILED on go-client. Trace attached to PR #482.

olga: pinging @raj @ben for a quick review. please check go-client parity — go batcher needs same pre-flush + dim guard. adding regression test for streaming reconnect + pagination.

raj: on it. for go the streaming lib handles auth refresh differently (it tries to rotate headers on the fly). i'll change it to perform a reconnect on auth rotation and mirror the py behavior.

ben: note about retries/backoff — if we reconnect aggressively the server might rate-limit. please honor Retry-After and implement an exponential backoff with jitter. naive backoff causes many simultaneous reconnects during token expiry window.

olga: agreed. also add a telemetry tag so ops can filter these reconnect-caused bursts: `reconnect_reason=auth_refresh` and `batch_flush_on_reconnect=true`.

mj: small UX ask — can we expose a client-level callback hook when dims change or reconnect happens so apps can surface clearer errors instead of cryptic stack traces?

ben: added a `on_reconnect(reason, meta)` hook in the py-client (opt-in) in the PR. go-client will get equivalent once tests pass.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-04-12T09:45:00 UTC failed for revision 3f8a2b — streaming reset rate exceeded threshold. Rolling back to 3f7d1c.

olga: ok let's hold releases until PR #482 and the go fix land. raj — can you target a small follow-up for the rate-limiting/backoff bits? aim for end-of-day.

raj: yes. i have a patch branch and i'll open PR today. will include: reconnect-only-on-auth, Retry-After support, and jittered expo backoff.

ben: CI green on py after fixing a flaky test (was assuming ordering during flush). going to re-run go tests after raj's patch.

ci-bot: CI: go tests now passing on branch raj/auth-reconnect. merging to main will trigger full integration.

olga: amazing. final asks before merge: add explicit dim check and clear error message, add regression test (simulate token expiry mid-stream + paginated rerank), document the recommended pattern in the SDK docs (example: graceful reconnect on auth refresh), and add short note to the 0.23.1 changelog.

sophia: thx all. i'll update the incident doc with steps we took and link PRs. :thumbsup:

ben: tagging PRs here: #482 (py batcher+dims+hook), #489 (py docs), #491 (go reconnect parity). please add reviews.

olga: assigning reviews: @raj on #482, @mj on #489, @ben on #491. closing the loop once merged.

sophia: resolved for now — keeping monitoring alert on for another 4h. if we see a recurrence we revert to sticky token window for long-lived streams as a fallback.

mj: FYI — added a short unit test that intentionally returns mixed-dim embeddings and asserts the batcher raises a clear ValueError. i'll push after CI run.

raj: PRs merged. rolling canary tomorrow morning with new backoff + dim guards.

sophia: perfect. thanks everyone.
